items.title: Amazon Hits $3 Trillion Market Cap for the First Time as Stock Closes At Record
items.summary: Amazon shares jumped 4.6% to $284.02 Monday, a new all-time closing high, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Amazon also closed above a market value of $3 trillion for the first time ever on Monday.  It’s the fifth company to reach this milestone, after  Apple Microsoft Nvidia  and  Alphabet  Amazon first closed above a $1 trillion market cap on Feb. 4, 2020 and notched a $2 trillion market cap on June 26, 2024.
